name: The Kitchin

menus.name: Surprise tasting menu
menus.note: Dinner, or lunch for guests arriving before 2pm; a vegetarian version costs the same. Cheese course £20 extra. Exclusive wine pairing £165, or £210 with Dom Pérignon. The whole table must take it

menus.name: Prestige surprise tasting menu
menus.note: The finest seasonal produce; dinner, or lunch before 2pm. Cheese course £20 extra. Exclusive wine pairing £165, or £210 with Dom Pérignon. The whole table must take it

menus.name: Three-course à la carte menu
menus.note: A choice of dishes at each course, lunch or dinner; three courses minimum. Some dishes carry a supplement (Wagyu £15, lobster £5)

menus.name: Set lunch
menus.note: Tuesday to Saturday lunch, with a vegetarian version; cheese instead of dessert £76.50, or four courses with cheese £79. Matched wines: three glasses £39, four £45

bookingOpens: Online through ResDiary on the restaurant's website, or by phone. Card details secure every booking, and the restaurant emails a link to reconfirm at least 24 hours ahead; unconfirmed bookings can be cancelled on the day. If nothing shows online, call reception, as tables free up at short notice.
cancellation: Cancel or change at least 24 hours ahead. Later cancellations and no-shows can be charged £45 a person at lunch and £90 a person at dinner; tables of eight have a 72-hour policy. Tables may be released 20 minutes after the booking time.
groups: For seven or more, call the restaurant. The private dining room seats up to 20, and the whole restaurant can be hired for up to 80.
dressCode: Smart casual; guests are asked not to wear sports jerseys.
